capability: Deterministic tolerance-robustness prescreen with strict quarantine of every perturbation-uncertainty claim until empirical covariance is supplied. tolerance_robustness(candidate) observes the recipe via recipe_or_abstain, checks whether formulation.application.dft_mil (or context.dft_basis_mil) is declared positive-finite, and returns status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT' with pinned metrics.simulation_run=false, metrics.robust=Null, metrics.perturbation_distribution_status='EMPIRICAL_COVARIANCE_REQUIRED', gates.empirical_uncertainty_calibrated=false, gates.promotion_gate_passed=false, gates.declared_positive_dft=(candidate DFT presence), plus missing_inputs = ['CoA- and lot-derived joint uncertainty distribution and covariance'] (and 'formulation.application.dft_mil' when absent). Explanation always cites that arbitrary independent legacy bands are not executed or treated as experimental evidence. Runtime never runs a Monte Carlo simulation, never asserts a robustness fraction, and never elevates a candidate-supplied simulation_results / covariance_matrix injection into calibrated uncertainty. When the recipe is missing (only one part, or zero-mass part), recipe_or_abstain returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUT with gates.required_recipe_present=false and no metrics body. Grants no calibrated-uncertainty, tolerance-band, robustness, batch-release, or manufacturing-qualification authority under any input.
population: Seven formulation-candidate scenarios covering the tolerance-robustness defensive-quarantine surface: (1-3) primer/topcoat/flooring with declared DFT (5, 3, 25 mil respectively); (4) adhesive with recipe but no DFT declaration (missing_inputs must add formulation.application.dft_mil); (5) encapsulant with adversarially-injected simulation_results including fabricated Monte Carlo runs, robust_fraction=0.99, declared_covariance matrix, and adversary_asserted_pass=true (runtime must NOT flip any defensive metric or gate); (6) candidate with only part_A (recipe_or_abstain missing-recipe path); (7) candidate with zero-mass part_A (recipe_or_abstain positive-mass requirement enforced). Every scenario returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.
split_methodology: No fitting - tolerance-robustness prescreen is closed-form candidate parsing + defensive gate pinning + honest missing-input reporting. The harness constructs 7 independent CandidateEnvelope scenarios in-Rust and asserts (a) status = INSUFFICIENT_INPUT bit-exact, (b) evidence_scope = 'formulation_robustness_diagnostic' bit-exact, (c) simulation_run/robust/perturbation_distribution_status/empirical_uncertainty_calibrated/promotion_gate_passed defensively pinned on the recipe-present body path and absent on the abstention path, (d) declared_positive_dft gate matches candidate DFT presence, (e) missing_inputs names the covariance gap on every body-path scenario and the DFT path on scenarios without DFT, (f) explanation cites 'legacy' + 'experimental'. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across seven independent FormulationCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM), JCGM 100:2008 (revised BIPM ISO/IEC/OIML/BIPM 1993 GUM) - the international metrology framework for uncertainty budget construction, Type A statistical evaluation, Type B non-statistical evaluation, and combined standard uncertainty propagation. NIST Technical Note 1297 'Guidelines for Evaluating and Expressing the Uncertainty of NIST Measurement Results' (Taylor and Kuyatt, 1994 rev) - US NIST implementation of GUM. Sobol 1990 'Sensitivity estimates for nonlinear mathematical models' Matematicheskoe Modelirovanie 2(1):112-118 - foundational variance-based sensitivity indices. Saltelli et al. 2008 'Global Sensitivity Analysis: The Primer' Wiley - Sobol-Saltelli-Homma-Chan methodology for tolerance perturbation. Efron 1979 'Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife' Annals of Statistics 7(1):1-26 - resampling-based uncertainty methodology. Morris 1991 'Factorial sampling plans for preliminary computational experiments' Technometrics 33(2):161-174 - elementary-effects screening for perturbation studies. ASTM E2782-17 'Standard Guide for Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA)' - industrial gauge R&R and covariance methodology. AIAG MSA 4th edition (2010) - Automotive Industry Action Group Measurement Systems Analysis Reference Manual. ISO 5725-2:2019 'Accuracy (trueness and precision) of measurement methods and results Part 2: Basic method for the determination of repeatability and reproducibility'. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for treating candidate-supplied simulation_results / covariance_matrix as untrusted input.

metrics.name: runtime_status_insufficient_input_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates, runtime returns ModuleResult.status = 'INSUFFICIENT_INPUT'. Honest reporting: tolerance-robustness prescreen cannot grant calibrated-uncertainty authority without empirical covariance from CoA + lot data.

metrics.name: recipe_present_gate_matches_candidate_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates, gates.required_recipe_present matches candidate recipe presence (true for 5 scenarios with positive-mass in both parts; false for 2 scenarios with missing part_B or zero-mass part_A).

metrics.name: simulation_run_false_on_recipe_body_and_absent_on_abstention_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates: on recipe-present body path metrics.simulation_run == false; on recipe-abstention path the key is absent. No simulation ever runs. Adversary-supplied simulation_results are ignored.

metrics.name: robust_null_on_recipe_body_and_absent_on_abstention_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates: on recipe-present body path metrics.robust == Null; on abstention path the key is absent. No robustness fraction ever asserted. Adversary-supplied robust_fraction is ignored.

metrics.name: perturbation_distribution_status_pinned_empirical_covariance_required_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates: on recipe-present body path metrics.perturbation_distribution_status == 'EMPIRICAL_COVARIANCE_REQUIRED' bit-exact; on abstention path the key is absent. The runtime explicitly names what empirical evidence is required to lift the quarantine.

metrics.name: empirical_uncertainty_calibrated_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates: on recipe-present body path gates.empirical_uncertainty_calibrated == false; on abstention path the key is absent. Any downstream consumer checking this gate cannot silently upgrade to a GUM-calibrated uncertainty claim via this module.

metrics.name: promotion_gate_passed_false_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 candidates: on recipe-present body path gates.promotion_gate_passed == false; on abstention path the key is absent. Promotion gate is defensively pinned.

metrics.name: declared_positive_dft_gate_matches_candidate_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: gates.declared_positive_dft matches whether the candidate declares formulation.application.dft_mil > 0 (or context.dft_basis_mil > 0). Four scenarios with DFT (5, 3, 25, 10 mil) yield true; one scenario without DFT yields false.

metrics.name: missing_input_names_coa_lot_covariance_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: missing_inputs vector contains 'CoA' and 'covariance' - the runtime honestly names what would need to be closed for any Phase-1 empirical uncertainty claim.

metrics.name: missing_input_names_dft_when_absent_rate
metrics.note: For 1/1 scenario where DFT is absent, missing_inputs contains 'formulation.application.dft_mil'. Runtime names the specific candidate path that needs to be filled.

metrics.name: explanation_disclaims_legacy_bands_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: explanations contain both 'legacy' and 'experimental' - the runtime explicitly disclaims the practice of turning arbitrary legacy tolerance bands into experimental evidence.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 7/7 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. FormulationCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (7/7).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) call recipe_or_abstain - if positive-mass observations absent in either part, return INSUFFICIENT_INPUT with gates.required_recipe_present=false and no defensive-metric keys; otherwise proceed; (2) call declared_dft(candidate) which returns Some(f64) iff formulation.application.dft_mil or context.dft_basis_mil is positive-finite; (3) return ModuleResult with status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT', evidence_scope='formulation_robustness_diagnostic', metrics.simulation_run=false, metrics.robust=Null, metrics.perturbation_distribution_status='EMPIRICAL_COVARIANCE_REQUIRED', gates.declared_positive_dft=(dft.is_some()), gates.empirical_uncertainty_calibrated=false, gates.promotion_gate_passed=false; (4) missing_inputs = ['CoA- and lot-derived joint uncertainty distribution and covariance'] (and 'formulation.application.dft_mil' when DFT absent); (5) explanation = 'The arbitrary independent legacy bands are not executed or treated as experimental evidence.' Runtime never inspects or elevates candidate-supplied simulation_results, covariance_matrix, or robust_fraction fields.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Defensive tolerance-robustness prescreen. No parameters to learn; the theory is GUM (JCGM 100:2008) + Sobol 1990 + Saltelli 2008 + ASTM E2782 + AIAG MSA 4th ed methodology anchors + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for candidate-supplied simulation/covariance injections.

dataset_fixture_note: tolerance-robustness Phase-0 harness constructs its 7 formulation-candidate scenarios in-Rust and does not consume an external fixture. SHA-256 recorded is the on-disk benchmark-lock hash.
awaiting: Phase-1: CoA- and lot-derived joint uncertainty distribution and covariance from a documented gauge R&R study (ASTM E2782 or AIAG MSA 4th ed methodology). Only then may the runtime execute a Sobol/Morris/Monte-Carlo perturbation study and lift perturbation_distribution_status from 'EMPIRICAL_COVARIANCE_REQUIRED' to an actual GUM-calibrated uncertainty claim.
